panels.title: Dataset activity rows / day
panels.description: INPUT (14) vs OUTPUT (15). One dump day → one bar.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDateTime(event_date) AS time,
  direction,
  sum(row_count) AS rows
FROM smf.stats_dataset_daily
GROUP BY time, direction
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  toDateTime(event_date) AS time,
  direction,
  sum(excp_sum) AS excp
FROM smf.stats_dataset_daily
GROUP BY time, direction
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Activity by hour (raw 14+15, uses SMF time)
panels.description: Uses date+time from the record so you see intra-day shape.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT hour AS time, direction, sum(cnt) AS rows FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfHour(parseDateTimeBestEffort(concat(toString(event_date), ' ', if(time = '', '00:00:00', time)))) AS hour,
         'INPUT' AS direction, count() AS cnt
  FROM smf.smf_14 GROUP BY hour
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfHour(parseDateTimeBestEffort(concat(toString(event_date), ' ', if(time = '', '00:00:00', time)))) AS hour,
         'OUTPUT' AS direction, count() AS cnt
  FROM smf.smf_15 GROUP BY hour
)
GROUP BY time, direction
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  direction,
  job_name,
  replaceRegexpAll(dsname, '[^\\x20-\\x7E]', '?') AS dsname,
  sum(row_count) AS rows,
  sum(excp_sum) AS excp
FROM smf.stats_dataset_daily
GROUP BY direction, job_name, dsname
ORDER BY rows DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  event_date,
  smf_system_id,
  job_name,
  replaceRegexpAll(dsname, '[^\\x20-\\x7E]', '?') AS dsname,
  volume_serial,
  count() AS rows
FROM smf.smf_17
GROUP BY event_date, smf_system_id, job_name, dsname, volume_serial
ORDER BY rows DESC
LIMIT 100
